# Road Warrior EV

## Business Description
Road Warrior Pro is India's leading platform empowering delivery riders from Swiggy, Zomato, Blinkit, and others to transition to Electric Vehicles (EVs). We help riders increase their income, track their performance via a unified dashboard, and earn rewards through a comprehensive referral program.

## Services
- Delivery Rider Registration & Onboarding
- EV Transition Assistance & Resources
- Analytics Dashboard for Riders (Earnings, Trips, Referrals)
- Referral Program with Monetary Rewards & Milestones
- Support for multiple Indian languages (English, Hindi, Kannada)
